simple.summary: בֵּית פַּצֵּץ (Bêyth Patstsêts) means Beth-Patstsets , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 21.

definitions.full: H1048. Beth Patstsets מַּצֵּץ בֵּית proper name, of a location in Issachar ( place of dispersion ) Josh 19:21 ; site unknown.
definitions.rootNote: from 1004 and a derivative from 6327 ; house of dispersion;
